exposure: 2018 National Institutes of Health (NIH) definition of bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD)
cohort: The study included 584 infants born at <30 weeks of gestational age.
finding: The three compared BPD definitions showed similar discriminative performance on long-term neurodevelopmental and respiratory outcomes at 2 and 5 years corrected age, with the 2018 NIH definition having less predictive power for neurologic outcome at 2 years compared to the 2001 NIH definition.
